style.why: The hook is excellent and memorable (the heaviest defeat in 57 years), which fits the style guide perfectly. The structure follows the 'hook -> development -> clue' format well. However, it loses a point because the final clue list (Smith, Gerrard & Emery) is slightly generic for an Aston Villa fan;
style.fix: Consider swapping one of the managers for a teammate to add more intrigue or specificity, e.g., 'I've played with McGinn, Luiz & Watkins' (wait, can't name self). Maybe 'I've shared a dressing room with the likes of Luiz, McGinn & Tielemans'. Or keep the managers but ensure they are distinct enough.
